Frontend plus WORKFLOW.md only.
0be1d2a (DEC-69) changes one line of adminNotes.ts, nothing else. The admin 0.18.1 Fixed line 'A payout's transfer reference is optional.' now reads 'Payouts no longer ask for a transfer reference.'

NOTES: features/whats-new/clientNotes.ts and adminNotes.ts hold entry 0.18.1, the approved draft word for word apart from the DEC-69 line. The client Statements line is split into a web item and an Android item, both worded 'Statements: ...'.

Each shell passes its own notes: ClientFrame and ClientWhatsNewScreen pass CLIENT_NOTES; AdminFrame and features/admin/account/AccountWhatsNewScreen pass ADMIN_NOTES. A search of both builds on 701a45c found no admin copy in the client dist and no client copy in the admin dist.
The newest entry's id is the current release; VERSION and the stale APP_VERSION are unused. Platform items filter with isNative() (forPlatform in whatsNewEntry.ts).

SEEN STATE: localStorage key boe.<scope>.whatsNew.<userId>, value = the last seen entry id, wrapped in try/catch like securityStore. Sign-out keeps it, each user of a shared device has their own, and a missing record counts as not seen. A per-run in-memory copy means a throwing storage shows the sheet once per run, never in a loop.
SHEET: WhatsNewPrompt (Modal 'What's new', 'Version <id>', Done) sits in ClientFrame's showsChrome branch and in AdminFrame next to MaturityDuePrompt.

It opens only when all hold: authenticated by login or restore; principal.accountState is active (adminRuntime maps admins to active, so admins are unaffected); unseen; overlay depth 0; device unlocked. The conditions must hold for two renders in a row, so a dialog opening in the same commit wins.
Any close (Done, close button, Escape, backdrop, Android Back) marks it seen; opening does not.
ESCAPE: Sheet has no document Escape listener; the overlay stack's window listener closes only the top entry. Every Sheet is rendered through Modal, which requires the stack.

CLIENT: route /profile/whats-new (session, client, back /profile), Profile Manage row between Reviews and Legal, added to CLIENT_LINK_MAP.profile. The page lists every entry, with 'Installed version' from readInstalledApp on native only (failure shows 'This device did not report it').

ADMIN: /account (role admin, no permission, back /overview) and /account/whats-new. An 'Account' link in the top bar next to Sign out, not in the sidebar. Link map: overview -> account, account -> account-whats-new.
AccountScreen shows name, email and role, the app version on native only, 'Read what's new', and Sign out.
ADMIN_TITLE truncates to one line, and ADMIN_ACTION is flex-none whitespace-nowrap.
WORKFLOW.md Release gains step 1: add a What's new entry per audience that has something to tell, or none.

COMPATIBILITY (rule 11): no API, contract, schema, header, cookie or token change and no new request. Released APKs and the previous release are unaffected; an images-only rollback shows no sheet, and the leftover keys are inert.
TESTS: WhatsNewPrompt.test.tsx (8) and WhatsNewNotes.test.tsx (2). There are no copy tests, so the DEC-69 line needs none (rule 10).

P-whats-new (DEC-68) built in one commit 7dda191 on track/p-whats-new: feat(whats-new): add release notes sheet, Profile and Account pages. Frontend plus WORKFLOW.md only.

WHAT: features/whats-new holds clientNotes.ts and adminNotes.ts (entry 0.18.1, the approved draft word for word; the client Statements line is split into a web item and an Android item, both kept as 'Statements: ...'), picked by whatsNewNotes() with appTarget().

Each build carries only its own audience's notes: Rollup prunes the appTarget() branch; checked STATIC by grepping both vite builds (no admin copy in the client bundle, no client copy in the admin bundle).
The newest entry's id is the current release; VERSION and the stale APP_VERSION are not used. Platform items filter with isNative() (forPlatform in whatsNewEntry.ts).

Seen state: localStorage key boe.<scope>.whatsNew.<userId>, value = last seen entry id, try/catch like securityStore. Owner is in the key, so each user of a shared device keeps their own. tokenStore.clear does not touch it, so sign-out keeps it. Missing record = not seen.
A per-run in-memory copy (createWhatsNewSeen) means a throwing storage shows the sheet once per run and never loops.

WhatsNewPrompt (Modal 'What's new', description 'Version <id>', one Done) mounts inside ClientFrame's showsChrome branch and in AdminFrame next to MaturityDuePrompt. Opens only when authenticated (login or restore alike), unseen, overlay depth 0 and device unlocked, after two consecutive renders, so a dialog opening in the same commit wins. Maintenance and the required-update screen unmount the frame, so it cannot show behind them. Marked seen on Done, close button, Escape, backdrop or Android Back (all call onDismiss); opening does not mark it.

Client: route profile-whats-new /profile/whats-new (session, client, back /profile), Profile Manage row between Reviews and Legal, added to CLIENT_LINK_MAP.profile. WhatsNewScreen lists every entry newest first, plus 'Installed version' from readInstalledApp on native only (explicit 'This device did not report it' on failure).

Admin: ADMIN_ACCOUNT_PATH /account (id account, role admin, no permissions, back /overview) and /account/whats-new (same WhatsNewScreen, back /account). Top bar 'Account' link next to Sign out at every width (new recipe ADMIN_ACTION_LINK in ui/recipes/shellAdmin.ts); not in the sidebar. Link map: overview -> account (the top bar is on every page; overview is the declared source), account -> account-whats-new.

AccountScreen (features/admin/account/) shows Name, Email, Role (Superadmin or Admin) from the session principal, App version on native only, a 'Read what's new' button link, and Sign out. No API call.
WORKFLOW.md Release list gains step 1: add a What's new entry with the new version per audience that has something to tell, or none; later steps renumbered (no references to their numbers found).

COMPATIBILITY (rule 11): no API, contract, schema, header, cookie or token change; no new request at all. Released APKs and the previous release are unaffected. An images-only rollback simply shows no sheet; the leftover boe.<scope>.whatsNew.* keys are inert. finding-64 (rollback target) does not change this lane.

TESTS (rule 10): WhatsNewPrompt.test.tsx (7: no record shows; same user not shown after Done or Escape and a reload; another user on the same device sees it; waits while another Modal is open then shows; waits while the device is locked then shows; throwing storage shows once per run). WhatsNewNotes.test.tsx (2: Android item hidden on web; web item hidden on Android).

RED CONTROLS (each a one-line mutation, restored and cmp-identical): 038909c6 missing record counts as seen (6 fail); 4be1608f close skips the storage write (2 fail); d915f468 key without user id (1 fail); cf73f2ae ignore overlay depth (1 fail); 7c6076f0 ignore device lock (1 fail); 5724e300 no per-run copy (1 fail); e08c5a1a platform filter shows all (2 fail).

GREEN on 7dda191, clean tree: 25f8dcc5 contracts npm ci + build; 54e962a2 frontend npm ci + npm run check (48 files, 456 tests passed; typecheck, lint, generate:api:check, build, boot check); 5bff7b7d build:client (android dist 17 assets, 958759 bytes; boot check passed); 0f1e54ab build:admin (boot check passed).

RUNTIME STEPS for the coordinator (UNVERIFIED, nothing run in a browser): web client: sign in as client A -> sheet 'What's new', 'Version 0.18.1', New/Improved/Fixed, the web Statements line and not the Android one; press Done (also try Escape or the backdrop) -> gone; reload -> no sheet; sign out, sign in as client B in the same browser -> sheet; Profile -> What's new (between Reviews and Legal) lists 0.18.1, no Installed version row on web.

Web admin: sign in -> sheet with the admin notes (if a maturity prompt also appears it may stack on top; close both); reload -> no sheet; another admin in the same browser -> sheet; top bar Account -> name, email, role, no App version on web -> Read what's new -> /account/whats-new lists 0.18.1; Sign out from Account works.
Optional check: in devtools, localStorage shows boe.client.whatsNew.<userId> = 0.18.1 after closing, and it survives Sign out.

DOUBTFUL / LEFT: (1) the optional-update sheet and MaturityDuePrompt open after their queries resolve, so What's new can open first and they stack above it; it never opens above one already open. (2) WebView localStorage surviving an APK update is not verified on a device. (3) the draft's admin Fixed lines on self-lockout, payout transfer reference and second-tab saving depend on lanes still landing; they ship word for word, so drop or reword them if a lane does not land. (4) admin copy says 'payout', 'Monthly payments' and 'transfer reference' as approved in DEC-68; the brief's copy rule bans references, so the maintainer may want to look at that line. (5) No Android run, no APK built.
